function.name: keyword_search
function.description: Find chunks by literal case-insensitive keywords. Use short specific terms or entity names, 1–3 words each. Returns IDs and abbreviated snippets; read promising chunks before answering.

function.name: semantic_search
function.description: Find chunks by semantic similarity when wording is unknown or keyword search is insufficient. Returns IDs and short snippets; use read_chunk for full evidence.

query.description: A natural language description of the evidence to retrieve.

function.name: read_chunk
function.description: Read full text for one to eight chunk IDs observed in search results. Use these text paragraphs to check evidence before answering.
